extracted.name: Texas Pie
extracted.description: This quick-to-make, big as Texas pie recipe features cherry pie filling, crushed pineapple, coconut, and pecans, all baked with a butter cake mix.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can crushed pineapple with juice
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).

Pour cherry pie filling into a 9x13-inch baking dish; top with pineapple but do not stir. Sprinkle cake mix over pineapple; sprinkle coconut over cake mix. Sprinkle pecans over coconut; pour melted margarine over top.
Bake in the preheated oven until top is golden brown, about 40 minutes.
